Sum of the widths of the breakers and devices (1 module = 18 mm). A two-pole breaker takes 2.

Sizes a panel according to RIC No. 02: enclosure capacity with the 25 % expansion required for a new installation, internal trays and clear working space in front of the panel.

Without an inverter the grid protection (RI) must be centralized.
A SEC-approved system that prevents exporting to the grid; it can exempt the reverse power protection.

Shows the protections RIC No. 09 requires for a self-generation system (for example, solar PV with net billing) based on its power and the service connection. Overcurrent and earth fault protection are always required.
Without a tray, zones 0 and 1 are measured as a radius from the water outlet (movable head) or from the fixed head.
From the edge of the bathtub or tray (0 = above it), or from the outlet or head if there is no tray.
Height of the appliance, socket or switch.
Optional. Above 2.25 m, zones 2 and 3 extend to the ceiling or up to 3 m.
Shows which RIC No. 11 zone a point in a bathroom or shower falls in, and the IP rating, devices and appliances it allows. Washbasins are treated as zone 2 up to 0.3 m around and above.
